# ⚖️ CR-FR-204 Works generated by an AI

**Status:** ✅ specified, ⚖️ lawyer review before launch (D574)

## Statement

(⚖️ lawyer review before launch, D574) A work generated by an AI without a human's creative choices may not be protected by copyright; the terms of
a promoted feature therefore rest on contract, not only on copyright.
